interpretation.functional_claim_rule: A fragment status of implemented or partial AND a nonempty ios.implementation_callsites array is a reported functional-source claim, not proof. Three handoff-only adaptations remain separate. Fifteen AI claims initially received via handoff are now in the refreshed AI fragment; pending shared wiring is not promoted to completion.
interpretation.assignment_rule: Reserved means the current user steering names the family, or an existing fragment owns that exact ID. Needs-assignment means no addressable reservation for the remaining family was supplied; a broad nearest domain is not silently treated as acceptance of the whole family.
interpretation.gap_union: unfragmented_packages[*].feature_ids UNION reported_without_functional_callsite_claims[*][0] = 377 distinct original IDs lacking JSON functional-callsite receipts. Subtract handoff_only_claims[*].id for 374 IDs with no source implementation claim in the read reports. Additional AI handoff groups are receipt-refresh history, no longer members of this gapset. An implemented adapter with unapplied shared hunks is not an integrated/verified port.
interpretation.source_category_for_every_id: Join id to source_inventory.features[].id. Preserve kind (setting/state/setting-template) AND android.behavior; apply the independent disposition lists below. ui-only/unresolved is not proof of inertness.
interpretation.android_anchor_for_every_id: Join by id in the pinned inventory: retain all android.references.effect and ui anchors; choose effect[0], else ui[0], else android.file/android.line as the compact first anchor. A fallback declaration/UI site is not labelled an effect. Per-file hashes are source_inventory.source_files. Package anchors below are actual representative source consumers.
interpretation.native_claim_anchor_for_every_reported_i: Use the matching pinned fragment's ios.implementation_callsites and implementation.evidence. These are implementer statements; no individual Swift/UI method was re-reviewed here.
interpretation.freeze_rule: If an input hash changes, this is a historical planning snapshot. Reconcile a new snapshot; do not rewrite the live client-features.json to make these counts fit.
interpretation.not_completion: Neither CoreSettings tests, a stored schema, an assigned owner, an imported package nor a partial fragment creates ported=true. This document grants no review pass.
